description: Slnmap (sln-map) — a semantic map of your .sln for AI coding agents. Analyze a .NET solution into a queryable code graph, serve it over MCP, and inspect index status.
releaseNotes:
New: `slnmap link` -- the cross-stack linker, the final piece of the
frontend-analysis project. Joins every FrontendCallSite (v0.11.0) to the C# Endpoint (v0.7.0/
v0.8.0) it actually hits: exact verb matching (an honestly-unresolvable verb is disclosed, never
guessed), route-precedence tie-breaking scoped to the one case it's actually knowable (a literal
call site beats a parameterized sibling endpoint), and a truthful set edge for real runtime
fan-out and irreducible ambiguity alike -- never a guessed single link. impact_analysis and
find_usages now continue straight through a C# handler into its frontend callers with no
separate query. Two new MCP tools, find_orphan_calls and list_frontend_callsites, close the
remaining coverage/listing gaps. Field-trial verified against a real, live production codebase:
407 of 434 real call sites (93.8%) link deterministically or via the precedence rule; every one
of the rest is individually disclosed by exact reason, including the specific production bug
that motivated this entire project. See CHANGELOG.md for details.
Source: https://github.com/EMahmoudNabil/slnmap
